subject: FinTrade goodwill remediation & tailored makegood package
messages:
From: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@fintrade.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Incident 2026-08-10 — production latency + batch job failures (requesting remediation)

Hi Vivek,

We saw degraded performance and failed batch ingestion between 02:30–03:15 PDT on 2026-08-10. This impacted two downstream pipelines (settlement and reconciliation) and caused delayed reporting for several merchant partners. Our ops team pulled logs and the attached usage_report_aug11.csv to show increased retries and token spikes.

This is the second significant outage in 11 months for us and we need to understand remediation and commercial relief. Can Redwood propose a makegood (credit/discount or free month) and confirm whether there are follow-up mitigations so we can share internally?

Our procurement/billing team is cc'd (billing@fintrade.com).

Thanks,
Carlos Vega
Senior Infrastructure Manager
FinTrade
attachments: usage_report_aug11.csv (CSV, 42KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@fintrade.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com> , Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Incident 2026-08-10 — production latency + batch job failures (requesting remediation)

Carlos — thanks for sending the logs and the clear context. I’m sorry for the disruption; we take these outages seriously. I’ve looped in Marissa (CS), Karthik (Sales leadership) and Lauren (Finance) to scope a remediation package quickly.

Short term, can you confirm the $$ impact range (estimated lost revenue or cost to remediate on your side) and whether FinTrade would prefer:
- a one-time credit applied to the next invoice, or
- a free month of service on top of a pro-rated credit, or
- a structured multi-month credit schedule tied to usage thresholds?

We’ll draft a proposal for exec sign-off today. I’ll also attach a short postmortem template for our incident summary once Marissa collates the telemetry.

— Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@fintrade.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Incident 2026-08-10 — production latency + batch job failures (requesting remediation)

Hi Carlos — we pulled the runtime traces and the attached incident_postmortem.pdf (initial draft) shows a cache-thrashing event on two dedicated GPU hosts during the ingestion window. That triggered elevated latency for batch workers and a small percentage of request failures; we’ve already patched the placement logic to prevent the same pattern.

Proposed customer-facing makegood options (pick one; we recommend option B given customer impact and relationship risk):
A) One-time credit equal to the prorated invoice for the 45 minutes of degraded service (applies to next billing cycle).
B) Credit equal to 1 month of service (capped at $75,000) + operational playbook and a dedicated postmortem with our SREs.
C) Tiered credit: 50% credit for next invoice + an additional 25% if the same class of incident reoccurs within 90 days.

If FinTrade prefers option B we’ll request exec sign-off because it’s above standard CS guidelines; I’m adding a short justification below.

Justification for elevated concession: FinTrade is a strategic enterprise with multi-year roadmap dependency on our streaming endpoints; churn risk is material and the customer has already escalated to their CRO. Offering the stronger remedy reduces immediate churn probability and preserves fee-for-service expansions.

Attachments: incident_postmortem.pdf (PDF, 180KB)

— Marissa
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Incident 2026-08-10 — production latency + batch job failures (requesting remediation)

Folks — looping in exec approvals path. I recommend we approve option B (1 month credit, capped at $75k) for the following reasons:
- Strategic account with active upsell pipeline (Q4 expansion opportunity).
- Repeat nature of incident within 11 months warrants stronger remedy to avoid CRO-level engagement.
- The proposed cap limits our downside while addressing the business impact.

Please confirm finance/legal ok with the amount and mechanics (credit vs. invoice waiver). If approved, I’ll confirm verbally with FinTrade and provide language for a short SOW amendment to be DocuSigned (no rate change; only commercial makegood).

Thanks,
Karthik
VP, Sales

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Incident 2026-08-10 — production latency + batch job failures (requesting remediation)

Karthik / team — finance reviewed the exposure and approves a capped concession aligned to option B:
- One month credit applied as an invoice waiver to FinTrade’s next billing cycle, capped at $75,000.
- If usage exceeds the cap, customer will receive the cap and we will discuss additional commercial remediation separately.
- Accounting will record as a customer credit; legal to prepare a short amendment to the SOW to document the makegood.

Lauren (Finance) will loop in Legal; please provide the exact SOW language you want to propose. Once legal provides the amendment, we’ll route for DocuSign.

— Lauren
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@fintrade.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, FinTrade Billing <billing@fintrade.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Incident 2026-08-10 — production latency + batch job failures (requesting remediation)

Carlos — thanks for your patience. We’ve reviewed the telemetry and approved a commercial makegood per FinTrade’s request.

Summary of approved remedy (final):
- One month of service credit applied as an invoice waiver, capped at $75,000.
- Dedicated postmortem session (SRE + FinTrade ops) scheduled this week; Marissa will follow up to coordinate timing.
- SOW amendment to capture the credit and confirm it is a one-off concession (no change to ongoing rates). Legal will send DocuSign for signature: https://www.docusign.com/send/abc123-fintrade-remedy

Please confirm acceptance and any billing contact preferences. We’ll process the billing waiver after the signed amendment is received.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
attachments: incident_postmortem.pdf (re-sent)
